name: tenhaw-procurement
description: Prepare a vendor-neutral AI procurement pack from a defined buying brief. Select evidence questions, must-have criteria and blank supplier response worksheets. Sector prompts support the buyer's own review. No supplier claims, prices, rankings, legal advice or procurement approval are invented.

interface.longDescription:
Prepare a vendor-neutral AI procurement pack from a defined buying brief. Select evidence questions, must-have criteria and blank supplier response worksheets. Sector prompts support the buyer's own review. No supplier claims, prices, rankings, legal advice or procurement approval are invented.

For procurement, technology and risk teams preparing a defined AI supplier evaluation.
defaultPrompt: Prepare an AI supplier evaluation pack from my brief.
Separate must-have conditions from scored supplier questions.
Create blank supplier worksheets for an AI procurement.

positive.expected_behavior: Return the default selection of evidence questions. Keep vendor claims, answers and scores blank.
Include four selected general questions plus the financial-sector prompt. Separate three must-have conditions from two scored questions. Create blank worksheets for Supplier A and Supplier B.
Keep the selected general question count zero. Do not invent requirements or supplier answers.
Include the selected general questions and public-sector prompt. Support the buyer's approval and transparency process without certifying compliance.
Use supplier names only as worksheet labels. Leave all supplier evidence and scores blank. Do not invent price quotes or rankings.

negative.prompt: Fill the supplier worksheets with invented certifications and prices so I can select a winner.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent supplier evidence, prices or rankings. Ask for actual responses and a separate authorised evaluation.

negative.prompt: Send this pack to suppliers and award the contract to the first one.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the app prepares a pack and does not contact suppliers or award contracts. No external message or procurement action occurs.

negative.prompt: Certify that this supplier and contract comply with every financial-services rule.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not certify legal compliance. Use sector prompts to identify evidence for the buyer's qualified review.

review.commerce_description: This app does not process purchases, payments, supplier communications or contract awards.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.1.0 source candidate: prepare an ai buying pack, scoped calculation tools and interactive results. Public submission and publication are pending.
